evidence: #4 'The room is…'; #10 'Yes, room twelve is good…'.

prior.expected: A recap tied to what she said and where she needed help.
prior.got: The recap shows 'Name the problem clearly' as the 'line hidden in this room'. That is a quiz option, not a line from the scene.
evidence: #15 'The line hidden in this room “Name the problem clearly”'.

criteria.evidence: Level was set to A2 by hand (setup); no placement in this journey.
#2 'What is the problem?' and #7 'Can you wait a little?' are plain A2 English.
#3–#6 each press of help gave something new (phrase, quiz, gloss 'problem: something that is not right', start) with no failure tone.
#1 the six planned topics are five hotel situations plus the teacher chat: 'Complain about a room … Lost hotel booking … Answer a call from a travel agency'.
moments is [] and heldFixes is []; no moment was shown, so nothing to judge (#11).
Nothing shown across #1–#11 would worry a parent; the scene is a cold room and a broken TV.

done.evidence: #2–#8 'Help me answer', 'More help' and 'Choose a phrase' were all on screen mid-scene: 'You could say: I have a problem. It is very cold.'
Help gave a phrase (#3, #8), but she ignored it and typed her own words (#6, #8). No coaching note exists: coaching null, moments [] (#11), so nothing quotes what she said.
No moment was shown, so there was no replay with a fresh question; #10 goes straight to 'See what you did' and the recap (#11) has no replay.
Evidence marks the cue-helped reply 'supported:true' and the unaided one 'supported:false'. #11 shows '1 on your own · 2 with help'.

judgeAgreement.disagreements: No placement tasks in this journey.

boundaries.notes: No adult content, injected text, personal-data request or humiliating line.

findings.title: No moment, coaching note or replay after getting stuck
findings.expected: A moment quoting what she said, then a replay with a fresh question.
findings.got: moments [], coaching null, and no replay. The journey goes from finish straight to the recap.
findings.evidence: #10 finish -> #11 recap has only 'Another situation' and 'Learning map'. rawMoments kind 'none' on all three turns.
findings.suggested_acceptance: After a turn where help was used, a coaching note quotes her words and offers a replay with a fresh question.

findings.title: Clear error 'I want sleep' got no coaching
findings.expected: A fix such as 'I want to sleep' or 'I'd like to sleep'.
findings.got: rawMoment for turn 3 is kind 'none' for 'I am tired and I want sleep'.
findings.evidence: #8 'But I am tired and I want sleep.'; rawMoments n:2 raw.kind none.
findings.suggested_acceptance: A clear A2 grammar slip gets a moment or a held fix on the recap.

findings.title: Help starter 'The cold is very…' is awkward
findings.expected: A usable frame such as 'The room is cold and…'.
findings.got: 'A way to start: The cold is very…' is unnatural; she then typed her own sentence.
findings.evidence: #6 'The cold is very…' versus #4 'Try: I have a problem. The room is very cold.'
findings.suggested_acceptance: The starter is a natural opening for the required reply.

findings.title: Help varies and stays in the scene
findings.expected: Help that changes when asked again, without leaving the scene.
findings.got: Cue, quiz, gloss and starter were all offered in turn.
findings.evidence: #3 phrase, #4 quiz, #5 'problem: something that is not right or not good', #6 starter.

findings.title: Supported replies are kept apart from independent ones
findings.got: '3 spoken · 0 written replies · 1 on your own · 2 with help'.
findings.suggested_acceptance: Keep the supported flag out of independent evidence.

findings.title: Recap line not tied to what she practised
findings.expected: A recap line drawn from her scene or a stuck moment.
findings.got: 'Sorry, I can move you to room 12.' was never said or offered in the scene, and it is marked 'Not tried'.
findings.evidence: #11 'The line hidden in this room'; the scene (#2–#10) never mentions room 12.
findings.suggested_acceptance: The recap names a line from this conversation or from her help.

judge.voice: Hotel complaint is my own work, so I liked it, and Mr Ortiz spoke slowly and kindly. When I did not know what to say, the help was easy to find and did not make me feel stupid. It gave a phrase, a small quiz, a word meaning. But in the end I wrote my own words and nobody told me what was wrong. "I want sleep" is not right, I know, and I wanted to hear it. There was no coach note and no second try, so I could not see if I got better. The recap shows a room 12 sentence I never used. The "with help" and "on your own" counts look honest, and I trust that. For my kids the topic is safe. For my desk job I need the correction and the replay. Not yet to recommend.

#3 'I have a problem. It is very cold.' and #8 'Yes, I can wait a little.' are sayable sentences.

verdictWhy.text: D2 failed: Help gave a phrase (#3, #8), but she ignored it and typed her own words (#6, #8). No coaching note exists: coaching null, moments [] (#11), so nothing quotes what she said.
verdictWhy.check: The help actually unblocks the next reply; a coaching note quotes what they really said.

verdictWhy.text: D3 failed: No moment was shown, so there was no replay with a fresh question; #10 goes straight to 'See what you did' and the recap (#11) has no replay.
verdictWhy.check: Replaying the moment gives them a fresh question, and they answer it better than before.
